public_claim_rules: Q/K/V must be captured after all model transforms used by the scored attention path.
attention scale, score bias/mask, and supported score transform must be explicit.
prefill plus cached-decode rows must both be present for public trace acceptance.
active_key_len must be mask-derived, not inferred from physical/static cache width.
cached-decode row position must use absolute active-key positions, not local q_len indices.
query-head to compact-KV-head ownership must be explicit and verified for GQA/MQA.
runtime RoPE position_ids must be explicit and verified separately from row/key positions.
probability semantics must declare float32 softmax, eval mode, and no dropout.
exact tokenizer prompt input_ids and attention_mask digests must bind trace rows to replayable prompt boundaries.
Exact prompt manifest with raw prompt text and explicit tokenizer-call settings must agree with prompt text/input_ids/attention_mask hashes before public acceptance.
exact generated sequence and generated suffix digests must bind cached-decode rows to replayable continuation tokens.
generation settings must be canonical, hash-checked, greedy, single-beam, single-return-sequence, use_cache=true, and min_new_tokens=max_new_tokens=decode_steps_requested.
generated_new_token_count_min and generated_new_token_count_max must both equal decode_steps_requested; early-stopped shorter continuations are not public-trace complete.
public model/tokenizer revisions must be immutable content/commit hashes and provenance-reviewed.
prompt text, tokenizer input_ids, attention masks, generated tokens, generation config, dense parity, and trace NPZ manifest must agree before public acceptance.
named-hardware end-to-end sparse-vs-dense timing and quality are required before performance promotion.
Runtime dtype, device placement, CUDA/device identity, timing-clock semantics, synchronization status, and elapsed capture time must be explicit and gate-verified before public trace acceptance.
Current package metadata must align on revision, revision_number, revision_int, current_revision_int, revision_name, package_name, and archive_name before any current run is trusted.
Trace capture elapsed time is diagnostic provenance only; speed/performance promotion requires a separate named-hardware sparse-vs-dense timing run with raw logs.

Selector-entry receipts must replay by digest against the input evaluation receipt, trace NPZ, provenance JSON, verifier tool, evaluator tool, and selector gate before downstream selector/cost evaluation.

Portable public-trace handoff archives must validate relative paths, subject digests, replay-tool identity, and selector-entry receipt replay after extraction before downstream selector/cost evaluation.
